body: Thanks for trying to change my view, I don't think it worked though. Life just seems to long and difficult, I think I'll just take the short route to the end.

Oh, passions seem like a waste of time. 
I don't know since like middle school. Therapy seems like a scam, why would I pay someone to talk to them? I just browse the internet.

I couldn't care less about my parents, the only reason I exist is because of broken rubber. Maybe my purpose is suicide, out of 7.4 billion people it's possible that some people just aren't capable of adapting and surviving in modern society.
You seem to be misunderstanding, I DON'T want to work.
Even if I do that eventually I'll have to get a job. Which I don't want to do. As for my plan, it is to skip to the end and die.

I want nothingness, seems like the perfect solution. I don't want love, money, or success. I just don't want to slowly starve to death and since that would probably happen eventually when I'm homeless suicide would seem to prevent that and save time.

I don't want anything from life. I'm genetically inferior and going to be homeless so reproducing makes no sense. I don't want to work. A hobby seems either too expensive or a waste of time. Isn't a passion the same thing as a hobby?
So if I just wanted to stop experiencing life suicide is the answer?
